race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle - 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
race.verdict: QUEEN OF CHRISTMAS has been off the track since disappointing in June but she's worth another chance to confirm debut promise at Nottingham, which has been massively franked by the first 2. Kodi Morse looks sure to leave his debut behind so is feared, while Geometric and Frontier Run are a couple of newcomers to note. QUEEN OF CHRISTMAS (IRE) KODI MORSE (IRE) GEOMETRIC (IRE)
